purpose: Evaluate something as the very definition of a quality.
keywords: Plain clause / N + というものだ
Blaming someone without explaining anything is simply unfair.
Helping each other in trouble is what being companions means.
Leaving it all to one person is simply unreasonable.
formation: Plain clause / N + というものだ
restrictions: Common in judgments of fairness, kindness, reasonableness, or selfishness.
mistake: This evaluates a situation; it is not merely naming an object.
